parameters.jsCode: const body = $json.body ?? {}; const expectedKeys = ['caseId','repairNeedId','reportedCategory','description','gettingWorse','safeToOccupy','imageUrls']; const categories = ['roof_water_intrusion','hvac','plumbing','electrical','windows_doors','accessibility','lead_environmental','structural','other']; const exactShape = Object.keys(body).length === expectedKeys.length && expectedKeys.every(key => Object.hasOwn(body, key)); const valid = exactShape && typeof body.caseId === 'string' && body.caseId.length > 0 && typeof body.repairNeedId === 'string' && body.repairNeedId.length > 0 && categories.includes(body.reportedCategory) && typeof body.description === 'string' && body.description.trim().length > 0 && typeof body.gettingWorse === 'boolean' && typeof body.safeToOccupy === 'boolean' && Array.isArray(body.imageUrls) && body.imageUrls.every(url => typeof url === 'string' && url.length > 0); if (!valid) throw new Error('Invalid HomeFix payload'); return [{ json: body }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: $env.HOMEFIX_AI_MODEL || 'gpt-4.1-mini', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'Normalize a resident home-repair report conservatively. Allowed repairCategory values: roof_water_intrusion, hvac, plumbing, electrical, windows_doors, accessibility, lead_environmental, structural, other. Allowed urgency values: low, moderate, high, critical. Never diagnose a condition or decide program eligibility, inspection eligibility, matching, coverage, funding, approval, or training approval. Generate 1–5 concise questions an on-site inspector should verify. Return only top-level JSON with repairCategory, urgency, summary, observations, safetyFlags, followUpQuestions, confidence, and trainingOpportunity. trainingOpportunity must contain status (not_suitable, potential, or requires_inspection), a non-empty reason, and possibleSkills (at most 8 strings). This is only a preliminary workforce-development signal pending professional inspection.' }, { role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ description: $json.description, reportedCategory: $json.reportedCategory, gettingWorse: $json.gettingWorse, safeToOccupy: $json.safeToOccupy }) }, ...$json.imageUrls.map(url => ({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url } }))] }], response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, temperature: 0.1 } }}

parameters.jsCode: const content = $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; if (!content) throw new Error('AI response missing content'); const value = JSON.parse(content); const expectedKeys = ['repairCategory','urgency','summary','observations','safetyFlags','followUpQuestions','confidence','trainingOpportunity']; const allowedCategories = ['roof_water_intrusion','hvac','plumbing','electrical','windows_doors','accessibility','lead_environmental','structural','other']; const allowedUrgencies = ['low','moderate','high','critical']; const allowedTrainingStatuses = ['not_suitable','potential','requires_inspection']; const strings = (items, max) => Array.isArray(items) && items.length <= max && items.every(item => typeof item === 'string' && item.trim().length > 0); const training = value.trainingOpportunity; const exactShape = value && typeof value === 'object' && Object.keys(value).length === expectedKeys.length && expectedKeys.every(key => Object.hasOwn(value, key)); const validTraining = training && typeof training === 'object' && Object.keys(training).length === 3 && allowedTrainingStatuses.includes(training.status) && typeof training.reason === 'string' && training.reason.trim().length > 0 && Array.isArray(training.possibleSkills) && training.possibleSkills.length <= 8 && training.possibleSkills.every(skill => typeof skill === 'string'); const valid = exactShape && allowedCategories.includes(value.repairCategory) && allowedUrgencies.includes(value.urgency) && typeof value.summary === 'string' && value.summary.trim().length > 0 && strings(value.observations, 6) && strings(value.safetyFlags, 6) && strings(value.followUpQuestions, 5) && value.followUpQuestions.length >= 1 && typeof value.confidence === 'number' && value.confidence >= 0 && value.confidence <= 1 && validTraining; if (!valid) throw new Error('AI response failed HomeFix contract'); return [{ json: value }];
